ABOUT
Nav Beacon is an Elite Dangerous outfitting bench.
Built and maintained by CMDR Dark Session.
Source code available on GitHub.
APP VERSION
0.1.46
LIBRARY VERSION
0.2.2
FAQ
Where are my builds stored?
In this browser, along with your preferences. Clearing site data deletes them, so export or share anything you want to keep.
Why do my engineered stats differ in game?
Rolls vary in quality in game. Nav Beacon shows every grade at 100% quality. A partial imported grade is raised to 100%, so the module is shown at the best roll of that grade rather than at the roll you have in game. A grade that cannot be raised refuses the whole import before anything opens, and your open build stays as it was.

ABOUT
Nav Beacon is an Elite Dangerous outfitting bench.
Built and maintained by CMDR Dark Session.
Source code available on GitHub.
APP VERSION
0.1.46
LIBRARY VERSION
0.2.2
FAQ
Where are my builds stored?
In this browser, along with your preferences. Clearing site data deletes them, so export or share anything you want to keep.
Why do my engineered stats differ in game?
Rolls vary in quality in game. Nav Beacon shows every grade at 100% quality. A partial imported grade is raised to 100%, so the module is shown at the best roll of that grade rather than at the roll you have in game. A grade that cannot be raised refuses the whole import before anything opens, and your open build stays as it was.
